Senior Backend Engineer, Platform Team (fictional company; test fixture for dmn sources)

About the role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer to join the platform team that runs our public
API, the payment ledger and the event pipeline behind them. You will design services that
handle millions of requests a minute, own them in production and help the rest of engineering
build on top of them safely.

What you will do
- Design and build distributed services in Go or Rust, with clear APIs and strong guarantees.
- Own reliability: service level objectives, alerting, on-call and blameless incident review.
- Scale our data layer: Postgres sharding, caching with Redis, and streaming with Kafka.
- Lead zero-downtime migrations and schema changes across teams.
- Mentor engineers and raise the bar for design reviews and code reviews.

What we are looking for
- Six or more years building backend systems that run at scale in production.
- Deep experience with at least one relational database and one message queue.
- A track record of improving reliability and cost, backed by numbers.
- Clear written communication; you write design documents people actually read.
- Experience with rate limiting, idempotency and exactly-once or effectively-once processing
  is a strong plus.

How we work
Small teams, written decisions, and a weekly production review. We interview with one system
design round, one coding round, one behavioral round and a conversation with the hiring
manager.
